overview: 本期共收录 3 篇论文。研究方向主要集中在金融经济学（2 篇）、风险管理与衍生品（1 篇）。方法上以随机过程、实验方法为主。来源分布：arXiv（3 篇）。

papers.title: Strategic Optimization of Bus Systems with Stochastic Ridership
papers.abstract: In global metropolitan areas, public transport benefits from bus systems. Bus design widely applies theoretical models, which typically assume static ridership. However, ridership randomness exists, and lack of attention to it might lead to wrong design decisions. Moving beyond static ridership, we extend the traditional single-line model with stochastic ridership. Further, to optimize the bus system under various ridership randomness, we introduce a hybrid model that combines conventional buses (CBs) and flexible buses (FBs). In both models, we apply a continuous approximation approach and find that: 1) Bus capacity increases with ridership randomness in the extended single-line model; 2) The hybrid model exhibits a binary state: either CBs serve the ridership with rejections under low ridership randomness, or CBs serve the majority while FBs serve the minority with rejections under high ridership randomness. Our findings establish a link between bus system design and ridership randomness, contributing to a more adaptive and efficient public transport framework.
papers.summary_zh: 【金融经济学】在全球大都市地区，公共交通系统显著受益于公交系统的存在。公交设计广泛采用了理论模型，但这些模型通常假设乘客流量是静态的。然而，乘客流量实际上具有随机性，若忽视这一因素，可能会导致错误的决策。为了超越静态乘客流量的假设，我们将传统的单线路模型扩展为包含随机乘客流量的模型。此外，为了在各种乘客流量随机性条件下优化公交系统，我们引入了一种混合模型，该模型结合了传统公交车（CBs）和灵活公交车（FBs）。在两种模型中，我们都采用了连续近似方法，并发现：1）在扩展后的单线路模型中，随着乘客流量的随机性增加，公交车的运载能力也随之提升；2）混合模型呈现出两种运行状态：在乘客流量随机性较低时，传统公交车承担大部分乘客运输任务，同时会有一定程度的拒载情况；而在乘客流量随机性较高时，传统公交车主要承担运输任务，灵活公交车则负责少数乘客的运输，并同样存在拒载现象。我们的研究结果揭示了公交系统设计与乘客流量随机性之间的关联，为构建更加灵活高效的城市公共交通体系提供了理论支持。。研究方法：随机过程。

papers.title: On the Pricing of American Options under Stochastic Local Volatility and Stochastic Correlation via the RBSDE Framework
papers.abstract: In this work, we study the pricing of American options under stochastic local volatility (SLV) models extended by including stochastic correlation driven by an additional stochastic process. We generalize the class of SLV models by incorporating a flexible stochastic correlation structure. To price options within these extended models, we derive the corresponding reflected forward-backward stochastic differential equations (RBSDEs) and employ data-driven numerical methods to solve them for both pricing and hedging purposes. The RBSDE framework enables the modelling of the future evolution of the option price. Furthermore, we conduct a convergence analysis of the proposed numerical method and present numerical experiments that illustrate the performance of the extended models, as well as the accuracy and efficiency of the RBSDE-based approach.
papers.summary_zh: 【风险管理与衍生品】在这项研究中，我们探讨了在包含由额外随机过程驱动的随机相关性机制的随机局部波动性（SLV）模型下美式期权的定价问题。通过引入灵活的随机相关性结构，我们对SLV模型进行了扩展。为了对这些扩展模型中的期权进行定价，我们推导出了相应的反射型前向-后向随机微分方程（RBSDEs），并采用数据驱动的数值方法来求解这些方程，以实现定价和对冲的目的。RBSDE框架能够模拟期权价格未来的演变过程。此外，我们对所提出的数值方法进行了收敛性分析，并通过数值实验展示了扩展模型的性能以及基于RBSDE方法的准确性和效率。。研究方法：实验方法、随机过程。

papers.title: Certified Alpha Capacity: Statistical Evidence, Economic Lifetime, and Arbitrage under Decay
papers.abstract: In this paper we study whether a trading signal can accumulate enough statistical evidence for reliable deployment before its economic value decays. We solve the problem by measuring statistical evidence and remaining opportunity on a common Kullback-Leibler information scale, obtaining an exact feasibility threshold in a canonical Gaussian model and general information lower bounds beyond it. We show that finite information budgets generate survival frontiers, search penalties, and a market equilibrium in which arbitrage activity shortens the lifetime of certifiable opportunities; a retrospective funding-rate study illustrates the role of persistence.
papers.summary_zh:
📌 研究问题：本文旨在探讨交易信号能否在价值衰减前积累足够的统计证据，从而实现可靠部署。

🔬 研究方法：研究通过在共同的Kullback-Leibler信息尺度上衡量统计证据与剩余机会，在标准高斯模型中推导出精确的可行性阈值及更广泛的信息下界。

📊 核心发现：研究发现有限的信息预算会产生生存前沿、搜索惩罚以及市场均衡，其中套利活动会缩短可认证机会的寿命。

💡 应用价值：该研究有助于理解套利活动对可认证机会寿命的影响，以及有限信息预算下的市场均衡机制。
